page: Google Cloud Platform n2d-standard-96 is a general-purpose virtual machine based on the x86_64 architecture. It is powered by an AMD EPYC 7B13 processor providing 48 dedicated physical cores and 96 virtual CPUs via simultaneous multithreading. The system includes 384 GB of system memory, maintaining a standard general-purpose ratio of 4 GB of RAM per vCPU. Cache sizing includes 32 KB of L1 data cache, 0.5 MB of L2 cache, and 32 MB of shared L3 cache. Instruction set extensions include AVX, AES, VAES, SHA-NI, and BMI2, though support for AVX-512 and AMX instructions is not present. This instance configuration includes no bundled local storage and provisioned GPU count is zero.

Benchmark results demonstrate high multi-threaded computational capabilities, highlighted by top-tier performance in multi-core stress-ng tests and PassMark encryption evaluations. Memory throughput is robust, delivering 214.48 GB/sec in large-block read operations and 113.87 GB/sec in write operations. Application benchmarks reflect strong throughput across data operations, measuring 84.24 million operations per second in Redis SET workloads and 46.3 GB/sec in static web serving. Software compilation speeds via Clang also achieve strong performance marks.

System limitations emerge in tasks dependent on single-threaded frequency and vector instructions absent on this platform. Geekbench scores and compression tasks such as gzip and bzip3 place in the middle tier. Furthermore, LLM text generation metrics reflect average throughput, and large 70B parameter generation is limited by lack of accelerator hardware. Because local disk storage is not bundled, high-throughput I/O requires network-attached storage integration.

The hardware configuration provides favorable resource density and operational efficiency for high-concurrency enterprise workloads. It is well suited for web serving fleets, enterprise application tiers, compilation pipelines, in-memory caching systems, and database operations that do not require dedicated hardware accelerators.
description: Google Cloud Platform n2d-standard-96 is a general-purpose compute instance equipped with 96 vCPUs across 48 physical cores of an AMD EPYC 7B13 processor alongside 384 GB of RAM. Operating on the x86_64 architecture, it delivers a balanced 4 GB of memory per core without integrated local storage or hardware GPUs. Benchmarks show top-tier multi-threaded processing and cryptographic performance, accompanied by high memory bandwidth and strong throughput in static web serving, software compilation, and Redis key-value operations. While single-thread efficiency and compression tasks remain moderate due to CPU architecture boundaries and the omission of AVX-512 extensions, the instance provides high compute density. It is appropriate for multi-threaded enterprise services, in-memory data caching, CI/CD compilation workloads, and database systems requiring substantial memory and parallel CPU execution.
